root_idea.summary: The root centers on two related principles: a gathered body of people, and standing upright or taking something up with resolve.
root_idea.development: From standing and undertaking arise meanings of establishing, maintaining, supporting, correcting, remaining firm, and valuing; the people-sense forms a separate root branch.

senses.definition: to stand or rise; to become standing, established, or operative
senses.usage_conditions: Used literally of rising or standing and figuratively of something coming into effect or being established. In contexts of resolve, it can introduce undertaking or proceeding to an action.

senses.definition: to set upright, establish, or put into proper order
senses.usage_conditions: Applies to a physical object, a path, an affair, a standard, or a proof when it is made upright or put right.

senses.definition: to maintain and duly perform an ordinance, prayer, or revealed law
senses.usage_conditions: In constructions such as establishing prayer or the Torah, the expression includes fulfilling its due requirements and maintaining it in practice, not merely performing an outward act.

senses.definition: to become or remain straight, upright, rightly directed, and firm
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a person, path, affair, or discourse; with a way or truth, it denotes continuing without deviation in the right course.

senses.definition: establishing or maintaining
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the verbal noun occurs in contexts of establishing and maintaining worship.

senses.definition: settling, staying, or establishing oneself in a place
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence refers to the stability or settlement provided by dwellings and encampments.

senses.definition: more upright, sounder, or more suitable
senses.usage_conditions: A comparative adjective describing a course, wording, measure, or way as more securely right or straight.

senses.definition: a standing place, station, position, or place of residence
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote a physical place of standing, a station or position, or a period and place of remaining; context determines the emphasis.

senses.definition: a place or condition in which one is made to stay; a resting place
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses emphasize a place of residence or rest, including the prospect of having no place to remain.

senses.definition: an abode of enduring residence
senses.usage_conditions: In دار المقامة, the feminine form denotes the abode in which residence continues permanently.

senses.definition: remaining, lasting, or enduring
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or substantivally for something that continues without cessation or for one who remains in a place.

senses.definition: one who establishes or duly maintains an ordinance
senses.usage_conditions: In المُقيمين الصلاة and related expressions, the active participle denotes those who maintain prayer by fulfilling its requirements.

senses.definition: straight, direct, even, or rightly directed
senses.usage_conditions: Used literally of a straight or even line and figuratively of a path, way, course, or conduct that does not deviate.

senses.definition: standing or upright
senses.usage_conditions: The QAC group also contains the verbal-noun-shaped forms قِيَامٌ and قِيَامٍ; these express the same standing condition in the supplied grouping.

senses.definition: maintaining, overseeing, or standing responsible for something
senses.usage_conditions: With على or ب, the participle can denote guarding, attending to, or administering a person, affair, or matter of justice.

senses.definition: standing, upright, established, or occurring
senses.usage_conditions: The feminine form describes a standing community or object and, in the expression concerning the Hour, an event that will occur or be established.

senses.definition: a balanced measure or means of support by which proper order is maintained
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of spending, the word denotes a balanced, neither-extravagant-nor-niggardly measure grounded in sufficiency and support.

senses.definition: a people, community, group, or associated body of persons
senses.usage_conditions: The older lexical description centers on men, while the Quran commonly uses قوم for an associated people including men and women; context determines the scope.

senses.definition: one who persistently upholds, manages, protects, or cares for others or a principle
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses apply the intensive form to sustained responsibility for people and steadfast commitment to God and justice.

senses.definition: upright, sound, correct, or true
senses.usage_conditions: Used of religion and related matters for what is firmly right, properly ordered, and valid.

senses.definition: upright, correct, or rightly ordered
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of the revealed writings and substantivally in the expression for the upright or true religion.

senses.definition: the one who sustains, guards, and maintains all existence
senses.usage_conditions: A divine epithet combining independent subsistence with sustaining and preserving every created thing and supplying what its existence requires.

senses.definition: the Resurrection, the arising of the dead, and the time of final judgment
senses.usage_conditions: The noun presents the coming of the cosmic standing or arising as a named eschatological event.

senses.definition: upright, sound, or rightly established
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic reading of ديناً قيماً, the form describes a religion that is firm and corrective of human affairs.

senses.definition: forming, proportioning, or giving sound constitution
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence concerns the well-proportioned constitution bestowed in creation, especially the human constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise at night for prayer; in a specialized expression, to spend the nights of Ramadan in prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A devotional construction distinct from the simple physical act of rising.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake, manage, supervise, maintain, or care for an affair or dependent person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes taking responsibility for an affair, an orphan, a child, or the maintenance of a woman; the examples do not impose a general object restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise up against or oppose someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic prepositional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be supported or sustained by something, or to subsist by means of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the means by which a person or thing is sustained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cost someone a specified amount or burden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive idiom concerning expense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become established in someone's mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use equivalent to something becoming settled or fixed in thought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To begin or set about doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The imperfect verb following قَامَ gives the construction its inchoative sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sun to become high, especially at midday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A time-of-day expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For water to congeal or freeze.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, explicitly marked figurative or assumed extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake an excuse on someone's behalf, so that it serves to excuse him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic construction in which something undertaken for a person functions as his excuse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To straighten, even, correct, or put something into right condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies to a crooked thing or anything requiring correction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To value, rate, estimate, or assign the price of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes assessing worth and setting a price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a writing, account, or reckoning accurate and exact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized corrective use applied to records and calculations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise against, withstand, oppose, or contend with an adversary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe opposition in contention or war.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be equal or equivalent to something, or to contend for equality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal Form III construction focuses on equivalence or matched opposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand with someone or assist them in accomplishing a needful affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction of cooperation rather than opposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To counteract or neutralize poisons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use attested in the supplied lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sustain or support someone, as food sustains a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative support use distinct from establishing an object upright.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand to a bet, wager, or stake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed construction concerning participation in a wager.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To inflict the legally specified punishment called حدّ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prescribed call announcing that the prayer is about to begin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical religious noun for the formula recited after the call to prayer, including قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, reside, dwell, or abide in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive Form IV residence use is distinct from causing something to stand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform or carry out an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general transitive use of Form IV.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand in someone's stead or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic substitution construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To establish evidence, proof, or an argument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal and argumentative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To continue, remain, wait, or stay intent upon an affair or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction combines continuance with sustained occupation or attention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To subsist or hold together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V development from support and stability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have a price or be valued.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of something whose worth can be assessed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To value or estimate something among themselves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction for collective assessment of price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's stature, height, or well-proportioned bodily form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal branch referring to bodily height and symmetry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man-shaped post or structure supporting a pulley and its apparatus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical object noun, also used for the pulley assembly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good stature, tallness, or symmetry of bodily proportion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal branch distinct from قِوَام meaning support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The support, mainstay, subsistence, or sustaining means of a thing or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the food or material support by which someone subsists and the power by which one can withstand another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A purging or flux of the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare medical usage unrelated to the ordinary standing sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manager, conductor, regulator, superintendent, or tender of an affair or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may describe administration of an affair, the affairs of a people, or the care of animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The real value, worth, or equivalent of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Lexically distinguished from a price in the narrower commercial sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The right or cardinal winds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural expression for winds coming from the principal directions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who rises frequently at night to pray.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A devotional intensive noun distinct from the Quranic sense of persistent upholding or stewardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Appearing or conspicuous, as though standing before the observer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can describe an object whether physically standing or lying down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leg or supporting upright of an animal, table, throne, or movable seat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the plural قَوَائِم for legs and supports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eye that has become white and blind while remaining intact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical anatomical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hilt of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The servants of a fire temple.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun preserved under the supplied lexical entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Winds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic or specialized plural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A technical kind of nibbing in which the pith and exterior of a reed are equal in length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized craft term contrasted with مُصَوَّب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Frozen or stagnant water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of water that is motionless or congealed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A standing-place or assembly, and by extension the persons assembled or a discourse delivered there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The later senses are explicitly presented as developments from the place of assembly and include a speech, exhortation, or literary session.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A precious stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexicalized adjective-noun expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rectum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical anatomical expression, not the ordinary adjective meaning straight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stellar calculations or astronomical reckonings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural technical noun.

cautions: The QAC قَائِم grouping includes the forms قِيَامٌ and قِيَامٍ as active-participle-derived material; they are retained under that public form because the supplied QAC grouping assigns them there.
قَوْم is lexically associated especially with men in part of the Classical evidence, but the Quranic usage commonly includes an entire associated people, including women.
The Quranic sense of قِيَم in ديناً قيماً reflects the supplied lexical discussion of an upright, corrective religion; it should not be conflated mechanically with every occurrence of قَيِّم.
